mandatory_constraints: One whole source policy: exact-time random activation, village-player setup and event veto, then object-owned bounded hostile attempt wave with delivery pacing and preconsumed opportunities. Enum states, each sample, timers, Zombie/chicken variants and failure branches are supporting0, not separate mechanisms.

Ordinary native startup includes VillageSiege in overworld custom-spawner list; current constructor stores that list. Reused actual ServerChunkCache runs custom dispatch only when doMobSpawning and non-debug path, forwards hostile/friendly flags without SpawnState or400-tick creature flag, and ServerLevel ignores individual return counts. This is not full spawn/cap or installed-world proof.

Own tick requires !level.isDay and hostile flag; friendly parameter unused. Else sets SIEGE_DONE and hasSetupSiege=false but does not clear count, spawn coordinates or nextSpawnTime. Host doMobSpawning false skips custom call, so own reset is not delivered then. Full scheduling, paused worlds and configuration remain outside guarantees.

Fresh siegeState is SIEGE_DONE. At exact (double)getTimeOfDay(0.0F)==0.5 it rerolls nextInt10 for TONIGHT versus DONE before other state checks. LevelTimeAccess ignores interpolation argument and delegates dayTime to DimensionType fixed/normal normalized time curve. This is an exact source equality, not proven once-per-night latch or guaranteed clock visit; if repeated delivered calls retain the same0.5 time they can reroll repeatedly. SIEGE_CAN_ACTIVATE appears only as unused enum state in full class.

If TONIGHT and !hasSetupSiege, setup loops current ServerLevel.players list in order, skips spectator but has no own isAlive filter; first player currently village and not tagged WITHOUT_ZOMBIE_SIEGES is selected. Native village predicate uses section distance to occupied VILLAGE POIs; not bed-count or Cat occupied-HOME quota. Native raw biome exclusion base tag lists mushroom_fields only; current loaded datapack tag is not established.

For that first eligible player it samples at most10 ring anchors using floor(cos/sin(angle)*32), player blockY, then findRandomSpawnPos. That helper samples at most10 X/Z in[-8,7] around anchor, obtains WORLD_SURFACE height, tests isVillage and Monster.checkMonsterSpawnRules(EVENT), and returns bottom-center. These are nested source sample budgets, not100 guaranteed distinct blocks, all players, terrain clearance or eventual successful location.

Monster predicate requires non-PEACEFUL, sky/block/raw brightness tests with dimension light thresholds and randomness, then native Mob.checkMobSpawnRules below-block isValidSpawn because EVENT is not SPAWNER. It does not itself test body/above emptiness/full bbox/worldborder or instance checkSpawnObstruction. Height lookup/chunk IO, complete light engine and native placement/category budgets unexpanded; no universal cap/event bypass or collision-safe spawn claim.

On first valid probe setup posts cancelable Forge VillageSiegeEvent carrying siege/world/player/probe Vec3. Cancellation returnsfalse before setting quota or nextSpawnTime. Tick leaves hasSetup false and TONIGHT unchanged on that normal false return, allowing later eligible calls to try again; event documentation saying stops siege is not proof permanent night suppression. Full event bus/external handlers not read. Probe location is not actual actor addition or stored exact final spawn location.

On noncancelled valid probe, setup sets nextSpawnTime0 and zombiesToSpawn20 then breaks only anchor loop. Even if ALL10 anchor probes failed, it still returns true for the first eligible player, without initializing quota/time. Tick then marks hasSetup true; no next eligible player search. Fresh zero quota can immediately finish without any zombie and return1; reused object may retain earlier leftover count/delay while anchor fields have changed. These are bounded same-source normal-return implications, not reproduced runtime exploits.

While active, positive nextSpawnTime decrements and returns0. Else resets2, then if remaining>0 invokes void trySpawn and decrements remaining after normal return; if already0 sets DONE yet returns1. Hence inter-attempt spacing is two subsequent positive-delay custom calls then next zero call, not guaranteed two wall ticks;20 is successful setup primary opportunities, not accepted births or even a strict total-actor cap. Terminal no-attempt pass still returns1.

Each trySpawn resamples near stored ring anchor rather than using the earlier event probe. Null position returns normally; factory or finalize exceptions are caught/logged inside try and return normally; outer tick still decrements these opportunities. Null factory is dereferenced inside that try, so ordinary NullPointerException is caught too. Move and add happen outside that catch; no promise all errors consume an attempt or are swallowed.

Factory registration is Zombie::new MONSTER, nullable EntityType.create respects enabled features. Caller finalizes EVENT using zombie.blockPosition difficulty BEFORE intended Vec3 move, unlike Cat move-before-finalize. No source guarantee that equipment/difficulty/nearby-entity work evaluates at intended wave location. Constructor/superclass/world hooks are not complete; do not claim an observed origin bug or live incorrect stats.

Bounded full Zombie.finalizeSpawn method delegates super, computes loot/baby/group/JOCKEY and equipment/attribute/holiday branches; baby chance and reinforcement defaults read through Forge config, not current values. A baby path may query existing Chicken or create/finalize/add one and request ride before outer zombie move, ignoring ride and chicken-add results. This means wave budget20 is not proof maximum20 total actors; secondary attempts/side effects are not new policy credits or accepted outcomes. External Chicken/equipment/attribute/constructor/world handler internals unexpanded.

After finalization own trySpawn moves Zombie to newly sampled Vec3 then calls void addFreshEntityWithPassengers, never checking native admission. Exact prior actual ServerLevel/manager support shows removed rejection, cancelable join event and duplicate UUID rejection; outer requested-opportunity debit still occurs on normal return. EVENT reason, count return, setup event, finalization or side-effect requests are not accepted native birth, death/loot, player damage/kill or material receipt.

Full135-line siege class has no own save/read/NBT method or durable pending wave receipt. Object reset/reconstruction, disabled-call freeze, exact-time reroll and stale quota/anchor cases remain explicit. No save/reload/night duration, all-world chance, one-world uniqueness, complete inherited entity persistence, globalcap behavior or current game deployment certified.

Whole-policy differences: EA1weather-clocked bounded beached encounter has no finite village setup veto/debited wave; EA2seedhabitat persisted giveup no delivered hostile quota; EA3/EA7table/predicate injection no direct object wave; EA9worldgen persistenthome cohort no clock/event cancellation; EA11trader-attached rider expiry no standalone wave. Cat occupiedHOME/local-density replenishment has no exact-time finitehostile budget. Shared clocks/helpers/ignoredadmission are0. Prior actual MainCat complete-decision reads reused, not old source chains reread.

Ordinary native startup includes VillageSiege in overworld custom-spawner list; current constructor stores that list. Reused actual ServerChunkCache runs custom dispatch only when doMobSpawning and non-debug path, forwards hostile/friendly flags without SpawnState or400-tick creature flag, and ServerLevel ignores individual return counts. This is not full spawn/cap or installed-world proof.

Own tick requires !level.isDay and hostile flag; friendly parameter unused. Else sets SIEGE_DONE and hasSetupSiege=false but does not clear count, spawn coordinates or nextSpawnTime. Host doMobSpawning false skips custom call, so own reset is not delivered then. Full scheduling, paused worlds and configuration remain outside guarantees.

Fresh siegeState is SIEGE_DONE. At exact (double)getTimeOfDay(0.0F)==0.5 it rerolls nextInt10 for TONIGHT versus DONE before other state checks. LevelTimeAccess ignores interpolation argument and delegates dayTime to DimensionType fixed/normal normalized time curve. This is an exact source equality, not proven once-per-night latch or guaranteed clock visit; if repeated delivered calls retain the same0.5 time they can reroll repeatedly. SIEGE_CAN_ACTIVATE appears only as unused enum state in full class.

If TONIGHT and !hasSetupSiege, setup loops current ServerLevel.players list in order, skips spectator but has no own isAlive filter; first player currently village and not tagged WITHOUT_ZOMBIE_SIEGES is selected. Native village predicate uses section distance to occupied VILLAGE POIs; not bed-count or Cat occupied-HOME quota. Native raw biome exclusion base tag lists mushroom_fields only; current loaded datapack tag is not established.

For that first eligible player it samples at most10 ring anchors using floor(cos/sin(angle)*32), player blockY, then findRandomSpawnPos. That helper samples at most10 X/Z in[-8,7] around anchor, obtains WORLD_SURFACE height, tests isVillage and Monster.checkMonsterSpawnRules(EVENT), and returns bottom-center. These are nested source sample budgets, not100 guaranteed distinct blocks, all players, terrain clearance or eventual successful location.

Monster predicate requires non-PEACEFUL, sky/block/raw brightness tests with dimension light thresholds and randomness, then native Mob.checkMobSpawnRules below-block isValidSpawn because EVENT is not SPAWNER. It does not itself test body/above emptiness/full bbox/worldborder or instance checkSpawnObstruction. Height lookup/chunk IO, complete light engine and native placement/category budgets unexpanded; no universal cap/event bypass or collision-safe spawn claim.

On first valid probe setup posts cancelable Forge VillageSiegeEvent carrying siege/world/player/probe Vec3. Cancellation returnsfalse before setting quota or nextSpawnTime. Tick leaves hasSetup false and TONIGHT unchanged on that normal false return, allowing later eligible calls to try again; event documentation saying stops siege is not proof permanent night suppression. Full event bus/external handlers not read. Probe location is not actual actor addition or stored exact final spawn location.

On noncancelled valid probe, setup sets nextSpawnTime0 and zombiesToSpawn20 then breaks only anchor loop. Even if ALL10 anchor probes failed, it still returns true for the first eligible player, without initializing quota/time. Tick then marks hasSetup true; no next eligible player search. Fresh zero quota can immediately finish without any zombie and return1; reused object may retain earlier leftover count/delay while anchor fields have changed. These are bounded same-source normal-return implications, not reproduced runtime exploits.

While active, positive nextSpawnTime decrements and returns0. Else resets2, then if remaining>0 invokes void trySpawn and decrements remaining after normal return; if already0 sets DONE yet returns1. Hence inter-attempt spacing is two subsequent positive-delay custom calls then next zero call, not guaranteed two wall ticks;20 is successful setup primary opportunities, not accepted births or even a strict total-actor cap. Terminal no-attempt pass still returns1.

Each trySpawn resamples near stored ring anchor rather than using the earlier event probe. Null position returns normally; factory or finalize exceptions are caught/logged inside try and return normally; outer tick still decrements these opportunities. Null factory is dereferenced inside that try, so ordinary NullPointerException is caught too. Move and add happen outside that catch; no promise all errors consume an attempt or are swallowed.

Factory registration is Zombie::new MONSTER, nullable EntityType.create respects enabled features. Caller finalizes EVENT using zombie.blockPosition difficulty BEFORE intended Vec3 move, unlike Cat move-before-finalize. No source guarantee that equipment/difficulty/nearby-entity work evaluates at intended wave location. Constructor/superclass/world hooks are not complete; do not claim an observed origin bug or live incorrect stats.
